results.title: 1995 - Hopes and Betrayals
results.overview: In 1995, Quebec faced a harrowing choice: remain part of Canada or establish itself as a separate country. The future of a nation and a lifelong dream were at stake in this referendum. Through interviews and analysis, journalists Antoine Robitaille and Dave Noël delve into the secret strategies, fierce rivalries, and political maneuvering of both sides.

results.title: Welcome Inn
results.overview: Amanda works in a cafe in the 1980's when strange customers start appearing.

results.title: Bradley Walsh's Million Pound Shot
results.overview: A brand-new quiz where contestants can win a million. But there's one huge secret twist in a night of drama, tension and life-changing outcomes. Would you take the shot?

results.title: Antonia Bembo : Ercole Amante @ Opéra de Paris
results.overview: Having fallen in love with his son’s fiancée, Hercules refuses to accept her rejection. Directed by Netia Jones and conducted by Leonardo García-Alarcón, the Baroque opera by Venetian composer Antonia Bembo makes its debut in the repertoire of the Paris National Opera.

results.title: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior
results.overview: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.

results.title: Whiskey Throttle
results.overview: When a lone outsider infiltrates a cartel-run motocross empire and walks away with its kingpin's fortune, he becomes the target of a deadly pursuit stretching 100 miles across the desert to the border.

results.title: Books Are Our Weapons
results.overview: A socially committed student commune gathers in its yearly camp to welcome new members, debate on feminism, culture critique and direct democracy, but also sit by the fireplace and sing songs of the movement.

results.title: On Memories of Countless Days Away
results.overview: Two friends recall their childhoods in Singapore, revisit their earlier films and perform a dance for which no recording remains. Their musings and archives are woven together in a meditation on how memories are not recovered, but composed anew.

results.title: The Mummy: Reckoning
results.overview: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.

results.title: Cartoon Physics
results.overview: When a four-year-old girl discovers a dead bird in the garden, her mother is swept into a world where reality unfolds like a cartoon. Inspired by a poem by Nick Flynn, this film is a meditation on a mother's attempt to protect her daughter's sense of wonder.

results.title: February, Seven Days
results.overview: After years of estrangement, single parent Arkadiy gets a visit from brother Igor and his son from Odesa. According to Jewish custom, they mourn their recently deceased mother while digging up old conflicts. As the war breaks out in Ukraine, the family is thrown into turmoil, and the brothers must take a closer look at their relationship to their homeland.

results.title: Tenfa
results.overview: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

results.title: The Bell: Panggilan Untuk Mati
results.overview: When a stolen bell unleashes the vengeful ghost of Panebok in Belitong, a shaman’s last descendant must recover the artifact and master forbidden rituals to stop its bloody rampage—before nine lives are claimed, including his own.

results.title: Beej
results.overview: Gurjot a Famous Painter in Chandigarh get's a visit from his long lost nephew. They reminisce about life in village but Soon his Nephews real intentions come to light. He has come to avenge his father.

results.title: Matcha Mountain
results.overview: Granny lives alone on Matcha Mountain. She rescues an injured balloon dog, addicted to matcha desserts by chance. Something begins to stir, and danger slowly creeps toward their fragile happiness…

results.title: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 1
results.original_title: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 1
results.overview: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 1 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on January 12, 2026, in Tokyo, Japan at Korakuen Hall. The event aired globally on CyberFight's video-on-demand service Wrestle Universe, and was main evented by an all-star tag team match pitting Marigold World Champion Miku Aono and former champion Utami Hayashishita against Marigold Superfly and GHC Women's double champion Mayu Iwatani and Marigold United National Champion Victoria Yuzuki.
